description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Revolutionist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
